section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces Study 2, which was conducted to replicate and increase confidence in estimates from Study 1, which had a small sample size. Study 2 utilized an existing dataset with a larger sample and a more thorough battery of Big Five measures, including the NEO PI-R, to allow for a nuanced differentiation of self-esteem from self-deception. The dataset also included indices of cognitive ability (IQ) and both academic and creative achievement, aiming to circumvent limitations of self-report.
